shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/commands/mod.rs && rg -n \"Date|since|until|TimeEntry|format_duration|No Project|report|search\" src tests README.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "toggl-cli entry stats date window project duration formatter" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && rg -n \"MockApiClient|Mock.*Client|normalize_time_entry_list_filters|TimeEntry \\{\" src/commands/test_utils.rs src/commands/list.rs src/commands/*.rs | head -120"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"pub fn normalize|fn normalize|format_duration|resolve_report_dates|pub struct TimeEntry|is_running\" src/utilities.rs src/models.rs src/commands/report.rs && sed -n '1,240p' src/utilities.rs"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"format_duration\" src/commands/search.rs src/commands/list.rs src/commands/report.rs src/utilities.rs; sed -n '235,285p' src/utilities.rs; sed -n '300,325p' src/models.rs; sed -n '350,430p' src/commands/search.rs"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- src/utilities.rs src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/commands/stats.rs'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-duration-formatting.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Keep new duration formatting centralized

New toggl-cli commands should use the compact hours-and-minutes formatter in "'`src/utilities.rs`, while existing report, search, and list output retains its legacy `H:MM:SS` rendering. This keeps the new output convention shared without changing established command output.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/commands/stats.rs | sed -n '1,80p'; nl -ba src/utilities.rs | sed -n '10,38p'; nl -ba src/arguments.rs | sed -n '150,195p'; nl -ba src/main.rs | sed -n '245,265p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short; git diff --check -- src/arguments.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/main.rs src/utilities.rs; git diff --numstat -- src/arguments.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/main.rs src/utilities.rs; wc -l src/commands/stats.rs'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '130,200p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '730,760p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '245,268p' src/main.rs; sed -n '1,150p' src/commands/stats.rs"
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "toggl-cli new commands JSON seconds total_seconds snake_case entry stats" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check -- src/arguments.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/main.rs src/utilities.rs; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-json-contract.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Standardize JSON output for new commands

Every newly added toggl-cli command should provide "'`--json`. JSON output must use snake_case keys, represent durations as integer seconds under `seconds`, and use `total_seconds` for grand totals. Human-readable duration formatting must remain separate from machine-readable JSON values.
EOF
mempal ingest "$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
/bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "toggl-cli stats no data empty JSON groups total_seconds" --json --top-k 5'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p "$HOME/.mempal-notes" && cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/toggl-cli-empty-results.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Make empty command results explicit

Commands that summarize or otherwise present a result set should treat an empty result as a successful outcome: human mode prints "'`(no data)` to stdout and exits zero. JSON mode should return the command'"'s normal empty schema with zero totals, keeping stdout machine-readable and avoiding errors or silence.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals

git diff --check -- src/arguments.rs src/commands/mod.rs src/main.rs src/utilities.rs && git status --short'
